remarks: A very special and charming Townhouse with water views in desirable Wilton Crest rarely comes on the market. This 2 bedroom, 2 1/2 bath home has been lovingly maintained and exudes that comfortable/cozy feeling the minute you walk in the door. The stunning living room with vaulted ceilings, ceiling fan, hardwood floor, fireplace and sliders leading out to deck/balcony is absolutely lovely. Spacious kitchen has breakfast area and sliders looking out to the expansive deck, making entertaining a breeze. Light-filled dining room with large windows and hardwood floors is perfect for your next dinner party. The desirable first floor Primary bedroom suite with ample closet space and sliders leading out to the deck provides the perfect sanctuary. Luxuriate in the spa-like bathroom with soaking tub, double sinks and stall shower. A powder room completes the first floor. Upstairs, you will find another light-filled bedroom and a full bath. The large lower level (650 sq ft) could easily be finished & provides great storage and garage access. The design of this Townhouse is so unique with a vaulted ceiling, cool angles, skylights, ample windows, pond views and two decks, including the huge and amazing 'Party Deck" which has just been sanded and painted. New carpet in the bedrooms and stairs, freshly painted kitchen cabinets & new lighting. This pristine home, surrounded by trees, is private & offers a lifestyle of convenience and low maintenance. Come see why Wilton Crest is so HOT!!
